In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the design process of the encryption algorithm should be done with the provable secure driven approach, which is based on a mathematical proof, and not with the cryptanalysis driven approach, which depends on the cryptanalysis of an existing algorithm.
the design of chaos based image encryption algorithm should be based on the provable secure driven approach.
chaos-based image encryption algorithms are not yet secure enough to be used in real applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cryptanalysis driven design approach should be abandoned for future chaos based image encryption algorithm designs.
the security of chaos based image encryption algorithm is still doubtful and it is necessary to design a provable secure algorithm.
, the security problems are inevitable for chaos based encryption algorithms as long as the cryptanalysis driven design approach is used.

security problems can be avoided in the design process if the security is taken into account in the design process.
the design of the security of the algorithm is the first step in the design process of the algorithm.
the security of the encryption algorithms is not guaranteed by cryptanalysis driven design.
